title: private-deploy-field-scratchpad
body:
Daily scratchpad - private deploys (notes + TODO)
Owner: Samira H.  quick running log for on-prem/VPC installs, customer-xyz

SUMMARY:
- Mid-install with customer-xyz (DC-nyc1). Primary blockers: customer firewall rules + HSM onboarding delays.
- Working config: k8s 1.26 (rke2), docker runtime disabled, using containerd. Must confirm kernel settings for hugepages.

OPEN ACTIONS / TODOs:
- [ ] Follow up with customer infra (Alex) to open TCP 2379/2380 from installer IPs and allow NFS mounts from 10.10.20.0/24. Ticket PROJ-4123.
- [ ] Get HSM onboarding ETA from security (Diego)  currently waiting on RA/CSR certs. affects KMS integration for private key wrap.
- [ ] Confirm SOC2 audit artifact requirements for private cloud (ask Emma).
- [ ] Run post-install health checks script and share output in /internal/installs/customer-xyz/2026-03-02
- [ ] Add canary routing rule in Redwood Console to route 5% to dedicated-hosted fallback for latency comparison.

INSTALL NOTES / COMMANDS (quick reference):
- Preflight: ensure ntp sync, disable swap, set vm.max_map_count=262144, net.ipv4.ip_forward=1.
- K8s bootstraps: rke2 server --token-file /etc/rke2/token --bind-address 0.0.0.0 --node-taint "dedicated=true:NoSchedule"
- CRI checks: containerd config at /etc/containerd/config.toml (patch log-level debug for first 30m)
- Disk layout: /dev/nvme0n1 -> /var/lib/rke2 (ext4, noatime); /dev/nvme1n1 -> /data/models (xfs, discard off)
- Hugepages: echo 2G > /sys/kernel/mm/hugepages/hugepages-2048kB/nr_hugepages (confirm with infra)

CUSTOMER ENV REMINDERS:
- Customer-xyz VLAN segmentation: management 10.10.20.0/24, app 10.10.21.0/24. Management nets have no outbound NAT  must use bastion for updates.
- No external DNS allowed; provide /etc/hosts mapping for internal package mirrors (mirror.internal.local -> 10.10.20.11).
- HSM: only PKCS#11 v2.40 supported, slot 0 locked until CSR signed.
- Backup policy: daily snapshot to S3-compatible endpoint (minio.customer-xyz.local), creds stored in vault path secret/private-deploys/customer-xyz

BLOCKERS / RISKS:
- Firewall rules not opened (blocks etcd gossip + external registry pulls) -> install fails at kubelet stage. Contingency: pre-push images to local registry (10.10.20.50) and set imagePullSecrets.
- HSM certificate delay -> cannot enable envelope encryption; will fall back to software KMS with strict audit log until HSM ready. Need change control note.
- SELinux currently enforcing on nodes; some vendor RPMs require permissive. Prefer ask infra to test with permissive in staging.

QUICK LOG (chron):
- 2026-03-01 09:30: initial onsite prep, validated rack power + switch mappings.
- 2026-03-01 11:45: attempted bootstrap -> failed etcd init, peer connections refused (PROJ-4170).
- 2026-03-01 13:10: worked with Alex to capture tcpdump. Found firewall dropping SYN from 10.20.30.12 -> requested rule.
- 2026-03-02 08:15: customer opened rule for 2379/2380; retried bootstrap -> progressed to kubelet config but stopped on image pulls (registry blocked).
- 2026-03-02 10:00: pre-pulled images to local registry, updated registry mirror config, restarted.

NOTES / REMINDERS TO SELF:
- Add runbook snippet for local-registry mirror setup (copy from maya-chen notes).
- When HSM ready: update /etc/redwood/kms.conf and rotate key2 -> key1 with 24h overlap. Document steps and rollback.
- Capture perf baseline: run loadgen @ 100 concurrent connections, 1k token length, record p95/p99 lat and token/sec.

CONVERSATION LINKS / REFERENCES:
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02ABCDEF/p1678901234567890 (installer logs)
- Infra PR for registry mirror: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842
- Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PD/pages/123456789/Private+Deploy+Runbook

QUESTIONS / TBD:
- Can we get a temporary NAT gateway to allow external registry pulls during install window? (ask infra ops)
- Do we want to enable privileged hostPath mounts for /dev/shm for model caches? security review needed.

----
End of scratchpad. Will convert to proper runbook once HSM and firewall issues resolved.
